title: Cookie Keybind Helper
description: Save, load, and manage multiple keybind profiles! Create different configs for PvP, building, or minigames. Switch between them instantly from the options menu. Perfect for players who need different control schemes!
body:
## Cookie Keybind Helper

Save, load, and manage multiple keybind profiles for Minecraft!

### Features:
- Save your current keybind configuration into named profiles
- Load any saved profile to instantly switch keybinds
- Rename and delete profiles
- Profiles persist across game restarts

### Perfect for:
- PvP configurations
- Building setups
- Minigame controls
- Different play styles

Access via Options > "Cookie Keybinds" button!
